summary: Trivial flag-reset helper. Clears the byte flag at this+0x58 (this[88]) to 0 and returns 0. No branches, no calls, no globals.

operations.description: Clear the byte flag at this+0x58 (this[88]) to 0 (packet literal 0).

unresolved: The meaning of the byte flag at this+0x58 and the object owning it are not established by the packet.
this+0x58 is rewritten to 0 on every call, so an external poke does not persist; no writer guard or owner class is known.
